room.name: [Dragon's Spine, Behind the Waterfall] (2280001)
room.description: Footing becomes quite treacherous here as each new step brings forth more uncertainty. Tiny rivulets of icy water trickle down from the waterfall and freeze, adding to the already slippery sheet of ice on the ground. The more adventurous traveler might either chance the dark woodlands ahead or ferret out some way to penetrate and attempt to swim the frozen river. The less daring of souls will quickly retreat from whence they came.
room.exists: You also see a rickety wooden signpost stabbed mercilessly into the ice and a small crack in the ice wall.
